title: The creature probe's bodies come up beyond the gate, six sentries stand at boot to meet them, and the heart is held while it runs
context: Owner, 2026-10-12: "don't spawn the enemies straight into the base without defense, it should be tested against sentries. spawn them beyond the gate, not inside the base, with some sentries already built." The probe's bodies came up at the sector's live breaches in turn (sector 2's back breach walks straight into the base) or on a ring 18 hops from the heart (inside the clearing); ?skip=defence builds no sentries; and the headed M4 run stalled at step 12 (300 small alive) because the unprotected sector was lost at ~40 s and the enemy loop stopped calling the probe.
outcome: THE GROUND (src/domain/probe-ground.js, pure, node-tested): gateHops is a BFS from the front gate's cell (story.gateCell) over open cells outside the clearing (story.inside); spawnBand keeps the cells lo..hi hops out whose way to the heart is the gate (distToHeart(c) >= distToHeart(gate) + hops - slack, so ground whose shortest way in is the back mouth is left out) and spreads up to `cells` of them farthest-point, at least `apartCells` apart; it is worked out again whenever the board's distToHeart array is replaced (a breach, the back door). On sector 2 of ?skip=defence: gate cell 30554, band 8-20 hops, 98 candidates, 19 cells used (hops 8 to 20), each probe body on the next one in turn; never a breach. SENTRIES AT BOOT: sentryCells picks buildable rock (the game's placeError) touching the outside ground within `reach` 3 hops of the gate, the story's two lane sockets (Rotor's and Quiver's, socketToward) first, 2 cells apart where the wall allows; built through commitTower(key, ci, 0), the chapters' own boot build. Default 6 in CREATURE_PROBE.sentries.mix order: Rotor, Quiver, Mortar, Rotor, Quiver, Relay (the four types ?skip=defence has earned: the base's Rotor and Quiver, the Relay and Mortar of its two pre-delivered expeditions); &sentries=N for any count 0..10 with or without the ramp. Cells: 51733 and 37040 (the sockets), 30555, 25599, 50994, 51730 (the wall either side of the gate). damageEnemy reports every hit to creatureEnemies.hit; the sentries' hits, damage and kills on creature records are counted. THE HELD HEART: while the probe runs, heartHit takes no damage (counted as held), loseGame returns early, and createSectorRun's new `hold` hook keeps a sector with every wave out from turning SECURE; once the card is up the game goes on as it would. THE CARD adds: sentries (count, types), sentry kills of the tier (all creatures, hits), the band (hops beyond the gate, cells), none / N inside the walls, heart held (damage taken off). &ramp=test now steps every 4 s for 75 s of wall time under a budget it never crosses, so the browser step can watch it keep stepping for a minute.
alternatives: keep the breaches as sources when they are outside: the back breach is outside the walls but its way in is the back mouth, not the gate; the owner asked for beyond the gate
the ring round the heart at a larger radius: still blind to the walls, the rock and which way in a cell takes
Isao's orders (orderTower) for the sentries: he flies and prints each one, so the baseline would start with half a garrison; commitTower is what a tutorial chapter's boot does
the lab's immortalHeart switch: it needs the lab on and does not stop a lost tank's loseGame nor a won sector's debrief pause
auto-continuing the debrief on a won sector: it starts the next sector mid-measurement; holding SECURE keeps the sector the probe was measuring
evidence: node test/probe-ground.mjs (a walled 41 x 41 grid with a back mouth: the band outside, on the gate's approach, spread; sockets first; the wall either side of the gate); node test/sector-run.mjs (a held sector stays fighting with every wave out, secured once let go); npm test 240 programs, npm run check, npm run build, npm run architecture (td-tab.js 6141 of 6400)

scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --creature-probe, CREATURES=cutis:small,cutis:huge,reed:small,reed:huge: all PASS. Per tier: 6 sentries {rotor 2, quiver 2, mortar 1, relay 1}; starts inside the walls 0 of 734 / 21 / 63 / 21 creature records; probe bodies beyond the gate 680/680, 16/16, 47/47, 16/16 (hops 8 to 20); sentry hits 1608 / 1263 / 82 / 530, kills of the tier 256 / 1 / 8 / 1; steps still rising at 63-69 s of wall time with sector 2 'fighting' (it fell at ~40 s unprotected); the card's lines present
--sector-probe SECTOR=4 PROBE_S=60 without the flags: the parent 99e72c40 and this branch give the same timeline (alive 79 / 161-165 / 469-471 / 569 at 14 s ..., lost at 40-42 s, lost-shown at 44 s)

--sector-probe SECTOR=2 PROBE_Q=&creatures=cutis%3Asmall&ramp=1&sentries=0: 43 damage held off the heart by 68 s, sector still fighting; PROBE_Q=&sentries=4 on sector 4: four sentries, still fighting at 48 s
